findings.reason: the node brief must either retain a bounded over-fetch for the sibling post-filters or move those predicates in-index too, rather than a blanket removal that reintroduces the starvation §16 exists to fix.
findings.text: §16 says to "remove the over-fetch, which the in-index filter makes unnecessary", but only the facility predicate moves inside SEARCH; the same functions keep other predicates as post-filters behind the same over-fetch — `_vector_search_signals` (search_tools.py:454-475) appends `s.diagnostic` and `s.physics_domain` to the post-filter list, and `_vector_search_wiki_chunks` (search_tools.py:807-845) post-filters `p.wiki_site`, `p.physics_domain` and `p.<score_dim>` — so a diagnostic-, site- or score-filtered query would again lose its matches to the global ANN cut.

findings.reason: §16 is to be dispatched as an implementable node and its brief must name the functions to edit; "those two queries" leaves the implementer to rediscover them.
findings.text: §16 says the "same two indexes are also queried by `domain_queries.py` … those two queries switch to the `facility_id` property", but it names only `find_code` and `_find_data_nodes_semantic` explicitly; the two AT_FACILITY post-filtering semantic queries that must actually change are `_find_signals_semantic` (facility_signal_desc_embedding, line 148) and `_find_wiki_semantic` (wiki_chunk_embedding, line 278), and neither is named.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the implementable sections extend one existing owner (`build_vector_search`'s `prefilter_clauses` plus the `vector_index_filters` slot annotation) rather than spreading new wrappers over the same machinery; §17 extends the single label-parameterised `embed_worker` rather than adding a parallel retry path.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16 names `imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py` as a change site but leaves its two in-scope AT_FACILITY queries as the unnamed "those two queries", so the node brief does not name `_find_signals_semantic` or `_find_wiki_semantic`, the functions it must extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §16 ("nothing added … the over-fetch constant is retired") and §17 ("no new `--reset-to` value or CLI surface appears") each name what they retire and add no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §16 reuses the in-index facility pre-filter but removes the ANN over-fetch without accounting for the sibling post-filters already present in the same functions (diagnostic/physics_domain in `_vector_search_signals`; site/physics_domain/min_score in `_vector_search_wiki_chunks`), which the over-fetch also compensates.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no new layer is added; §16 and §17 each retire surface (the `max(k*2, 50)` over-fetch expression; the "to retry, clear the property manually" instruction), and §17 explicitly extends the owner instead of adding beside it.
